message:
## Vulnerability Digest

Daily sweep completed for the monitored product list in Products.txt, covering the last 24 hours ending with the scheduled run on 2026-06-15 IST. I did not find any high-confidence, newly reported vulnerabilities in the last 24 hours that clearly match the monitored products. One Grafana-related distribution package advisory surfaced during the sweep, but the underlying upstream Grafana advisories appear older, so it is listed below for review rather than treated as a confirmed new product vulnerability.

**Confirmed findings**

No relevant new vulnerabilities were confirmed for the monitored products in the last 24 hours.

**Possible matches needing review**

- Product: Grafana
- Issue: openSUSE Tumbleweed grafana update referencing CVE-2026-25680 and CVE-2026-42506
- Severity: Moderate in the openSUSE package advisory.
- Description: A June 14, 2026 openSUSE Tumbleweed package advisory reports a Grafana 11.6.14 security update that addresses two CVEs.
- Why review is needed: The monitored list includes Grafana, but this source is an openSUSE package advisory rather than an upstream Grafana disclosure for the monitored environment. The Grafana Labs advisory index shows the recent upstream Grafana advisories I could verify were published before this 24-hour window, so this may only matter if openSUSE-packaged Grafana is in use.
- Sources: LinuxSecurity/openSUSE advisory https://linuxsecurity.com/advisories/opensuse/opensuse-2026-11013-1-grafana-11-6-14; Grafana Labs advisory index https://grafana.com/security/security-advisories/

**Fresh items excluded after review**

- GL.iNet GL-MT3000 CVE-2026-12186, Mattermost CVE-2026-6346, and CodeAstro CVE-2026-6201 / CVE-2026-12175 were published or updated in the window, but they do not match the monitored product list.
- Microsoft June Patch Tuesday, VMware VMSA-2026-0004, Ubuntu OpenSSL/nginx notices, Chrome and Firefox updates, Veeam advisories, and PostgreSQL/MongoDB items found during the sweep were excluded because the credible primary publication date was outside the last 24 hours or the match was not specific enough to the monitored products.

Closing note: No immediate action is recommended from this 24-hour sweep based on confirmed fresh findings. The only follow-up is to verify whether any monitored Grafana deployments use openSUSE Tumbleweed packages; if not, the Grafana package advisory can be treated as informational.
